Nina (Growth): Quick sync 06: webinar + launch post SEO checklist. Need final keywords, Event JSON-LD, 3-question FAQ, internal-link targets, and redirects sheet by Tue.
Eli: Preliminary keywords: 'production-grade LLM inference', 'inference cost optimization', 'dedicated model serving'. Will pick primary 2.
Zoe: For schema, we should include Event + FAQPage on the registration page and Article schema on the blog post. Minimal Event JSON-LD below:
```
<script type="application/ld+json">{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Event",
  "name": "Redwood Inference: Launch + Benchmarks",
  "startDate": "2026-06-08T18:00:00Z",
  "location": {
    "@type": "VirtualLocation",
    "url": "https://redwood.ai/webinar/register-launch"
  }
}
</script>
```
Nina (Growth): Redirects: map campaign and legacy pages -> /webinar/register-launch. Example (Netlify): `/legacy/webinar  /webinar/register-launch  301`
seo-bot: Crawl alert: 5 pages with missing canonical tags. See report: https://internal/seo/2173456780 (auto)
Eli: I'll run Linkinator and post orphaned pages list by Mon AM.
Zoe: Drafting FAQ Qs: 1) What latency can I expect? 2) Can I self-host? 3) How is pricing structured? Will post copy for QA.
Nina (Growth): Assign: Eli -> final keywords + hero copy by Mon noon; Zoe -> JSON-LD + FAQ draft by Mon EOD; Nina -> compile redirect spreadsheet and request EngOps deploy window.
Nina (Growth): If anyone sees overstated performance claims, flag here. Pre-publish sweep Wed morning. :rocket:
